notes.title: Yugo 2.2 Now Out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’ve been listening to your feedback and are excited to roll out an update to improve your experience in Yugo: The non-game. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Public Sessions List[/h3]

Now, you can browse a list of ongoing sessions to join rather than relying solely on the "Join random session" button. Each session shows the session name and how many people are currently along for the ride. In the future, we may add more details, like the preferred language for each session.

[h3]Drive the Yugo in Your Language[/h3]

Yugo is now available in Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French, making it easier for you to dive into the experience from wherever you are. If you spot any issues in the translations, please let us know—we’d be happy to improve them.

[h3]Voice Feedback Cancelling[/h3]

To make conversations clearer, especially when using speakers, we’ve added voice feedback cancelling. Now, you can chat more comfortably even without headsets.

As always, feel free to reach out on our Discord channel with any feedback or suggestions.
Thanks for being part of this journey with us!

– In Two Minds Studio

notes.title: The New Yugo Is Finally Out!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to announce the release of 2.0 Version of Yugo: the non-game! This update brings some of your highly requested features and improvements on other aspects of the non-game.

We sincerely appreciate the kind and encouraging comments that have motivated us to keep working and updating the project. A special thank you to all the players who have supported us and patiently awaited these updates.

Below is a list of the new changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Public sessions are finally a thing!![/b] You can still talk privately with your friends and also join random sessions with strangers.
[*] [b]Your own radio stations![/b] The radio has been updated to feature fully customizable radios. ​Radio stations can be added and removed and they will automatically sync with everyone else in the car.​ We provided a website database to find the stream URLs and you can find most of the internet radios there.
[*] [b]Revamped driving mechanics![/b] We have completely reengineered the way the car drives, handles and feels.
[*] Self driving is also much smarter now allowing you to have a smoother ride.
[*] We added a few maps, so each drive can feel a bit different and new.
[*] And a multitude of optimization techniques and smaller features that make it a majorly improved experience.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new version, and we’re always happy to hear your thoughts and feedback!​​

All the best,
In Two Minds Studio
